Now, we need to create a whole number in the denominator. To do this, we make an equivalent fraction by multiplying both the numerator and denominator by [MATH: 10\mathbin{:}]

Content:

Now, сarrying out the long division process, as usual, we get:

Content:
| | | | [MATH: 3] | [MATH: \!\! . 5] | [MATH: 2] | [MATH: 8] | / | [MATH: \!25] | [MATH: \!\!\require{enclose}\enclose{longdiv}{\,8 {\:\phantom{|}} 8 {\, . \,}2 {\:\phantom{|}} 0 {\:\phantom{|}} 0}] | / | [MATH: -\!\!\!\!] | [MATH: 7] | [MATH: 5] | | | | / | | [MATH: 1] | [MATH: 3] | [MATH: 2] | | | / | [MATH: -\!\!\!\!] | [MATH: 1] | [MATH: 2] | [MATH: 5] | | | / | | | | [MATH: 7] | [MATH: 0] | | / | | | [MATH: -\!\!\!\!] | [MATH: 5] | [MATH: 0] | | / | | | | [MATH: 2] | [MATH: 0] | [MATH: 0] | / | | | [MATH: -\!\!\!\!] | [MATH: 2] | [MATH: 0] | [MATH: 0] | / | | | | | | [MATH: 0] | |
